TEXT.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

S.FORM: Irou ka madama-ato, ni-kmi'ym ki sou ta Sibavau ka Tama-P'hik ki Mamoumou-appa ki ta'u sadadoumma ti Jesus-an tou pakapatei-an-ei tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: When the morning was come, all the chief priests and elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death:
到了早晨，眾祭司長和民間的長老大家商議要治死耶穌，

S.FORM: Ka rou ni-bæuut tyni-æn, ni-addneyn padarang ka ni-pæ'æ̈-tounnoun tyni-æn ti Pontius Pilitus ka Tæ'i-sou ki pourough.
S.TRANSL: And when they had bound him, they led him away, and delivered him to Pontius Pilate the governor.
就把他捆綁，解去，交給巡撫彼拉多。

S.FORM: Anna ta ni-kavoulas-sen ti Judas ka ni sivanavana-ato tyni-æn, rou kytt'an tyn ka dung-dung-en-ato ta teni, ni-âli kough tyn mad ki toutourou kyttiæn ki malyttouk ki Sibavau ka Tama-P'hik ki Mamoumou-appa-râ.
S.TRANSL: Then Judas, which had betrayed him, when he saw that he was condemned, repented himself, and brought again the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,
這時候，賣耶穌的猶大看見耶穌已經定了罪，就後悔，把那三十塊錢拿回來給祭司長和長老，說：

S.FORM: K'ma, Ni-mavarau-koh, ki sivanavan'an ta 'æmagh ka matiktik. Râ ni-k'ma ta neni, Mangaumi-æn? Ymhou ta kmytta-ah.
S.TRANSL: Saying, I have sinned in that I have betrayed the innocent blood. And they said, What is that to us? see thou to that.
「我賣了無辜之人的血是有罪了。」他們說：「那與我們有甚麼相干？你自己承當吧！」

S.FORM: Jrou ka ni-'aryng tyn ta malyttouk smaki-koua tou Kouva ki tatamd-den ki Alid, ni-d'marang-atou-râ, irou ka ou-koun, ni-mæu-said.
S.TRANSL: And he cast down the pieces of silver in the temple, and departed, and went and hanged himself.
猶大就把那銀錢丟在殿裏，出去吊死了。

S.FORM: Jrou ka æughin ki Si-bavau ka Tama-P'hik ta malyttouk, ni-koun nein, Assi hahei-en ka sacyt-eih ta anna tou poukakou'an ki ni-pap'hik-an, alei ka na kidi ki assa ki æmagh ta anna-râ.
S.TRANSL: And the chief priests took the silver pieces, and said, It is not lawful for to put them into the treasury, because it is the price of blood.
祭司長拾起銀錢來，說：「這是血價，不可放在庫裏。」

S.FORM: Jrou ka maki-kaha kmi'ym ki sou, nipeila nein ki anna ta ouma ki Tama-toulou ki rangi, tou raravakeih ki tæ'ækoua [neini-æn.]
S.TRANSL: And they took counsel, and bought with them the potter's field, to bury strangers in.
他們商議，就用那銀錢買了窯戶的一塊田，為要埋葬外鄉人。

S.FORM: Ka alei ki anna na-pananang-en ta ouma k'anna, ouma ki æmagh, tou kidi-appa ki wæ'i hnyn.
S.TRANSL: Wherefore that field was called, The field of blood, unto this day.
所以那塊田直到今日還叫做「血田」。

S.FORM: Anna ta ni-pafte ta na sousou ki Tama-mattæ'i-tan ka ti Jeremias, ka ni-koun tyn, Ka ni-æugh nein touro kyttiæn ki malyttouk, ta angal ka kidi ki na alalak ti Israël, ki ni-sikidi-en nein.
S.TRANSL: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremy the prophet, saying, And they took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him that was valued, whom they of the children of Israel did value;
這就應了先知耶利米的話，說：「他們用那三十塊錢，就是被估定之人的價錢，是以色列人中所估定的，

S.FORM: Ka ni-p'hæn nein ta anna alei ki ouma ki tmatoulou ki rangi, tou ahkoua-an ki ni-sikidi-en ti JEHOVA jau-an.
S.TRANSL: And gave them for the potter's field, as the Lord appointed me.
買了窯戶的一塊田；這是照着主所吩咐我的。」

S.FORM: Ka ni-jtou-douma mitouhko ta ti Jesus ki Tæ'isou ki pourough, ka ni-tmaligh ta Tæ'isou, k'ma, Mei-sasou kow kaua ka Si-bavau ki Joden? Ni-k'ma ta ti Jesus tyni-æn, Pattæ'irouk-en-hou.
S.TRANSL: And Jesus stood before the governor: and the governor asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And Jesus said unto him, Thou sayest.
耶穌站在巡撫面前；巡撫問他說：「你是猶太人的王嗎？」耶穌說：「你說的是。」

S.FORM: Ka tou pat'barau-en tyni-æn ki Si-bavau ka Tama-Phik ki Mamoumou-appa, assi tyn-pattæ'i-v'lli-en ta mamang.
S.TRANSL: And when he was accused of the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.
他被祭司長和長老控告的時候，甚麼都不回答。

S.FORM: Anna ta ni-k'ma ta ti Pilatus tyni-æn, Assi kow millingigh papynna ta pattæ'i-hail nein sadadouma ymhou-an?
S.TRANSL: Then said Pilate unto him, Hearest thou not how many things they witness against thee?
彼拉多就對他說：「他們作見證告你這麼多的事，你沒有聽見嗎？」

S.FORM: Râ assi ni-pattæ'i-v'lli-en tyn ki sasasat ki sou tyni-æn, komma-hynna ka ouhang ni-mourynh-gau ta Tæ'i-sou.
S.TRANSL: And he answered him to never a word; insomuch that the governor marvelled greatly.
耶穌仍不回答，連一句話也不說，以致巡撫甚覺希奇。

S.FORM: Ka na kidi ki kadæ'æm-en tou Ouvavoutoug-han ka â-sâteih-mæ'æumia ki Tæ'i-sou ta ni-pou-sangat ki makoilalaulau, timamang lava ka kamoei-in nein-da.
S.TRANSL: Now at that feast the governor was wont to release unto the people a prisoner, whom they would.
巡撫有一個常例，每逢這節期，隨眾人所要的釋放一個囚犯給他們。

S.FORM: Ka ni-akoumea nein tou kidi k'anna saat ki væuut-en-ato ka mæmægh ki varau, ka ni-saki-nanang-en ti Barabbas.
S.TRANSL: And they had then a notable prisoner, called Barabbas.
當時有一個出名的囚犯叫巴拉巴。

S.FORM: Jrou ka ni-papæu'i-sâl ta neni, ni-k'ma ta ti Pilatus neini-æn, Timang ta kamoei-'noumi ka æumi-au-mau-kamou, ti Barabbas kaua? ti Jesus kaua, ka siouwa ti Christus?
S.TRANSL: Therefore when they were gathered together, Pilate said unto them, Whom will ye that I release unto you? Barabbas, or Jesus which is called Christ?
眾人聚集的時候，彼拉多就對他們說：「你們要我釋放哪一個給你們？是巴拉巴呢？是稱為基督的耶穌呢？」

S.FORM: Râ kavanan tyn ka ni-pæ'æ̈-tounnoun ta neni tyni-æn alei ki ni-'æ'æs-sen tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: For he knew that for envy they had delivered him.
巡撫原知道他們是因為嫉妒才把他解了來。

S.FORM: Jrou ka mierrong ta teni tou Jerrarong-an ki æu-pæpænæh-hen, ni-madingi ta kei'æn tyn pakavana tyni-æn, ka komma koua, Ynna oumamang ki Matiktik k'anna: nda madagh ta ni tub'bhen-nau hnyn ki euvan k'atta tou malling alei tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: When he was set down on the judgment seat, his wife sent unto him, saying, Have thou nothing to do with that just man: for I have suffered many things this day in a dream because of him.
正坐堂的時候，他的夫人打發人來說：「這義人的事，你一點不可管，因為我今天在夢中為他受了許多的苦。」

S.FORM: Râ ni-pa-taumha ta Si-bavau ka Tama-P'hik ki Mamoumou-appa ki makoilalaulau, ka toumimi-au nein ta ti Barabbas, papakapatei ti Jesus-an.
S.TRANSL: But the chief priests and elders persuaded the multitude that they should ask Barabbas, and destroy Jesus.
祭司長和長老挑唆眾人，求釋放巴拉巴，除滅耶穌。

S.FORM: Ka ni-mattæ'i-vlli ta Tæ'isou ki pourough, k'ma neini-æn, Timang ki rarouha k'atta ta kamoei'noumi ka æumi-au-mau-kamou? Ka ni-k'ma ta neni, Ti Barabbas.
S.TRANSL: The governor answered and said unto them, Whether of the twain will ye that I release unto you? They said, Barabbas.
巡撫對眾人說：「這兩個人，你們要我釋放哪一個給你們呢？」他們說：「巴拉巴。」

S.FORM: Ni-k'ma ta ti Pilatus neini-æn, Mang-aul-at'mau ta ti Jesus, ka siouwa ti Christus? Ni-kmæi-beiaveiah tyni-æn, Ndâ pouna-væværæh-auh.
S.TRANSL: Pilate saith unto them, What shall I do then with Jesus which is called Christ? They all say unto him, Let him be crucified.
彼拉多說：「這樣，那稱為基督的耶穌我怎麼辦他呢？」他們都說：「把他釘十字架！」

S.FORM: Râ ni-k'ma ta Tæ'i-sou ki pourough, Kamang ta na varau tyn? Ka pakosaoun-neyn mako-toun, k'ma, Papounævæværæh-auh.
S.TRANSL: And the governor said, Why, what evil hath he done? But they cried out the more, saying, Let him be crucified.
巡撫說：「為甚麼呢？他做了甚麼惡事呢？」他們便極力地喊着說：「把他釘十字架！」

S.FORM: Jrou ka hmauat ta ti Pilatus, ka assi tyn paka-saoun-nen milligh, râ nipaka-saoun-nen appa ta karakkarak-an, ni-æugh tyn ta raloum, ka ni-madynnau ki rima tou æmæh ki makoisasal, ka ni-koun tyn, Aousi-koh ki varau ki papoutatiri-en ki æmagh ki matiktik katta: Hmauattâ ta ymoumi-râ.
S.TRANSL: When Pilate saw that he could prevail nothing, but that rather a tumult was made, he took water, and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, I am innocent of the blood of this just person: see ye to it.
彼拉多見說也無濟於事，反要生亂，就拿水在眾人面前洗手，說：「流這義人的血，罪不在我，你們承當吧。」

S.FORM: Ka ni-mattæ'i-vlli ta makoitatmouk ka ta'u, Æmagh tyn ta mouhalap-â ymi-ænæn, ki allalak-appa-miæn.
S.TRANSL: Then answered all the people, and said, His blood be on us, and on our children.
眾人都回答說：「他的血歸到我們和我們的子孫身上。」

S.FORM: Anna ta ni-æumi-en tyn pæ'æ̈ koua neini-æn ta ti Barabbas, jrou ka ni-smaplat ti Jesus-an, ni-pæ'æ̈tounnoun tou pounavæværæh-eih tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: Then released he Barabbas unto them: and when he had scourged Jesus, he delivered him to be crucified.
於是彼拉多釋放巴拉巴給他們，把耶穌鞭打了，交給人釘十字架。

S.FORM: Anna ta ni-patoulam ta Tama-macyt ki Tæ'i sou ki pourough ti Jesus-an, paoukoua teini-an tou keirang-en ki papæ-mæmæghan, ka ni-papæu'i-tmouk nein papæui'sal tyni-æn ta makoitatmouk ki sât ka-ylyl-lan.
S.TRANSL: Then the soldiers of the governor took Jesus into the common hall, and gathered unto him the whole band of soldiers.
巡撫的兵就把耶穌帶進衙門，叫全營的兵都聚集在他那裏。

S.FORM: Jrou ka ni-æumi-en nein ta pammi-'en tyn, ni-papah-kouvar ta neni tyni-æn ki kouvar ka mama ki apoei [ka patagh.]
S.TRANSL: And they stripped him, and put on him a scarlet robe.
他們給他脫了衣服，穿上一件朱紅色袍子，

S.FORM: Jrou ka ni-tynnoun nein ta saki-rou ka na adum, ni-pakaboungo-en nein tyni-æn ta atta, pou-koua ki angto-appa tou rima ka ouwal tyn, ka rou mata ly-kourog tou doumma tyni-æn, ni-bylla vylla tyni-æn, k'ma, Tabe meisasou ka Si-bavau ki Joden.
S.TRANSL: And when they had platted a crown of thorns, they put it upon his head, and a reed in his right hand: and they bowed the knee before him, and mocked him, saying, Hail, King of the Jews!
用荊棘編做冠冕，戴在他頭上，拿一根葦子放在他右手裏，跪在他面前，戲弄他，說：「恭喜，猶太人的王啊！」

S.FORM: Ka rou ni-madipagh tyni-æn, ni-ara nein ta angto, ka ni-v'llat tou voungo tyn.
S.TRANSL: And they spit upon him, and took the reed, and smote him on the head.
又吐唾沫在他臉上，拿葦子打他的頭。

S.FORM: Jrou ka ni-bylla-vylla tyni-æn, ni-'æumi-en nein ta kouvar, ka ni-papah koulamough nein ki nipammammien tyn, ka ni-æddnein tou pounavæværæh-eih tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: And after that they had mocked him, they took the robe off from him, and put his own raiment on him, and led him away to crucify him.
戲弄完了，就給他脫了袍子，仍穿上他自己的衣服，帶他出去，要釘十字架。

S.FORM: Jrou ka tpæpænæh ni-kabalei nein ta voual ka makka Cyrenen, ka ti Simon ki nanang: ka ni yhgarei-en nein pa-aval ki navævæværæh tyn.
S.TRANSL: And as they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name: him they compelled to bear his cross.
他們出來的時候，遇見一個古利奈人，名叫西門，就勉強他同去，好背着耶穌的十字架。

S.FORM: Jrou ka jerrou-'ato tou yttou-koua-an, ka pananang-en-ato Golgotha, ka siouwa jtoukoua-an ki toktok,
S.TRANSL: And when they were come unto a place called Golgotha, that is to say, a place of a skull,
到了一個地方名叫各各他，意思就是「髑髏地」。

S.FORM: Ni-payt tyni-æn ki mapyngit ka ni hou-rad ki parno: jrou ka ni kdiman-nen tyn, ni-ynnang myt.
S.TRANSL: They gave him vinegar to drink mingled with gall: and when he had tasted thereof, he would not drink.
兵丁拿苦膽調和的酒給耶穌喝；他嘗了，就不肯喝。

S.FORM: Jrou ka ni-pounavæværæh tyni-æn, ni-patatæh nein ta ni-pammammien ki na pakkiau: alei ka pavut-auh ta na sou ki Tama-mattæi-tan, Ni-mæisâl matætægh ta neni ki pammami-en-au, ka ni-pakk'jau alei ki koulamough-au.
S.TRANSL: And they crucified him, and parted his garments, casting lots: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, They parted my garments among them, and upon my vesture did they cast lots.
他們既將他釘在十字架上，就拈鬮分他的衣服，

S.FORM: Ka dou mierroung, ni-kmading tou hynna tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: And sitting down they watched him there;
又坐在那裏看守他。

S.FORM: Ka ni-pou-koua-an nein pou vavau ki voungo tyn ta na sasoulat ki ni-alei-en patbarau tyni-æn, Ti atta ta ti Jesus ka Mei-sasou ka Sibavau ki Joden.
S.TRANSL: And set up over his head his accusation written, THIS IS JESUS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
在他頭以上安一個牌子，寫着他的罪狀，說：「這是猶太人的王耶穌。」

S.FORM: Tou kidi k'anna ni-poulamen tyni-æn pou-navæværæh ta rarouha ki Tama-lpogh, tou ouwal ta sasat, tou u-'i ta sasat.
S.TRANSL: Then were there two thieves crucified with him, one on the right hand, and another on the left.
當時，有兩個強盜和他同釘十字架，一個在右邊，一個在左邊。

S.FORM: Râ neni ka hmarivat, ni-mako-avavagh tyni-æn bikbik ki voungo nein,
S.TRANSL: And they that passed by reviled him, wagging their heads,
從那裏經過的人譏誚他，搖着頭，說：

S.FORM: K'ma, Ymhou ka kuhta-kow ki Kouva ki tatamd-den ki Alid, ka mei-ringei ki anna [mei-likough] tou toutourou ki wæ'i, nda mæ'æu-mado hmamia ymhou-an. Heiro Alak kow ki Alid, mou-rarim-mâ ki navæværæh.
S.TRANSL: And saying, Thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days, save thyself. If thou be the Son of God, come down from the cross.
「你這拆毀聖殿、三日又建造起來的，可以救自己吧！你如果是上帝的兒子，就從十字架上下來吧！」

S.FORM: Mahkaulaula k'ma-hynna ta Si-bavau ka Tama-P'hik ki Makou-sasoulat, ki Mamoumou, ki Fariseen-appa, dou bylla-vylla, ni-k'ma ta neni,
S.TRANSL: Likewise also the chief priests mocking him, with the scribes and elders, said,
祭司長和文士並長老也是這樣戲弄他，說：

S.FORM: Pani ki voual ta ni-hami'an tyn-râ assi mæ'æu-lpough mæ'æu-mado hmamia tyni-æn. Heirou Mei-sasou ka Si-bavau ta teni ki Israël, ndâ mou-rarim-mâ hnyn ta teni ki navæværæh, ka tnamsing-ah-kame tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: He saved others; himself he cannot save. If he be the King of Israel, let him now come down from the cross, and we will believe him.
「他救了別人，不能救自己。他是以色列的王，現在可以從十字架上下來，我們就信他。

S.FORM: Ni-mas'hut ki rÿh ki Alid: nda hamiauh tyn hnyn tyni-æn, heirou akou-moei tyni-æn ta teni. Kou ni-k'ma ta teni, Alak koh ki Alid ti jau.
S.TRANSL: He trusted in God; let him deliver him now, if he will have him: for he said, I am the Son of God.
他倚靠上帝，上帝若喜悅他，現在可以救他；因為他曾說：『我是上帝的兒子。』」

S.FORM: Ka teni ki atta ni-pæu-nanæi tyni-æn ta Tama-lpogh, ka ni-pou-lam-en-ato pounavæværæh tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: The thieves also, which were crucified with him, cast the same in his teeth.
那和他同釘的強盜也是這樣地譏誚他。

S.FORM: Ka na kidi ki ka annum ki tæ'lei ni-jerroua ta karimdum-man tou myhta tmouk ki Næi, tou kidi-appa ki kamamatouda ki tæ'lei.
S.TRANSL: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land unto the ninth hour.
從午正到申初，遍地都黑暗了。

S.FORM: Ka mahivat-ato ki kamamatouda ki tæ'lei, ni-makou-langæh ta ti Jesus ki yngau ka irang, k'ma, Eli, Eli, Lama-Sabaghthani, ka ynna-ahkoua-an-ei, Alid-au, Alid-au, kaumang ka ni-d'marang-kow pa-itou-sât jau-an?
S.TRANSL: And about the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani? that is to say, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?
約在申初，耶穌大聲喊着說：「以利！以利！拉馬撒巴各大尼？」就是說：「我的上帝！我的上帝！為甚麼離棄我？」

S.FORM: Ka rarouma ka mitouhko hynna, rou illingh-en nein [ta atta,] ta ni-k'ma, Tmætææ̈m ti Elias an ta ti atta.
S.TRANSL: Some of them that stood there, when they heard that, said, This man calleth for Elias.
站在那裏的人，有的聽見就說：「這個人呼叫以利亞呢！」

S.FORM: Ka madys saat neini-æn ta ni-sioum mara ki na vadiou, ka mama ki pourout, ka rou ni-pou-t'moei-en tyn ki mapyngit, ni mali-ryttoung mali-vyt ki na angto, ka ni-payt tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: And straightway one of them ran, and took a spunge, and filled it with vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink.
內中有一個人趕緊跑去，拿海絨蘸滿了醋，綁在葦子上，送給他喝。

S.FORM: Râ ni-k'ma ta rarouma Os'eito, k'ytt'ei-mytta, ma lava ka irou'ah ta ti Elias hmamia tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: The rest said, Let be, let us see whether Elias will come to save him.
其餘的人說：「且等着，看以利亞來救他不來。」

S.FORM: Ka dou mila mako-ligh ki yngau ka irang ta ti Jesus, ni myhtaraæuh ki hynnaua.
S.TRANSL: Jesus, when he had cried again with a loud voice, yielded up the ghost.
耶穌又大聲喊叫，氣就斷了。

S.FORM: Ka kytt'ei, ni-papouhdouha ta varit ka kouvar ki Kouva ki tatamd-den ki Alid, makka vavau tou kidi-appa ka tou rarim: ka ni-ninugh ta Næi, ka ni-mæuæsæs ta vahto.
S.TRANSL: And, behold, the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom; and the earth did quake, and the rocks rent;
忽然，殿裏的幔子從上到下裂為兩半，地也震動，磐石也崩裂，

S.FORM: Ka ni-mouhtlægh ta ravaravak, ka madagh ki vouel ki ma-d'lligh matiktik, ka ni-mei-rip, ta ni-pæ'æhpit-en-ato.
S.TRANSL: And the graves were opened; and many bodies of the saints which slept arose,
墳墓也開了，已睡聖徒的身體多有起來的。

S.FORM: Ka rou ni-'tpæpænæh-hen nein makka-rbo ki ravaravak si-äugh ki ni-patimææ'-æn [pææh-pit] tyni-æn, ni-ierroua ta neni tou 'æuma ka ni-pa-itou-nni tou tatamd-den ki Alid, ka ni-moupæ-næh tou æmæh ki mabatoung [ki voual.]
S.TRANSL: And came out of the graves after his resurrection, and went into the holy city, and appeared unto many.
到耶穌復活以後，他們從墳墓裏出來，進了聖城，向許多人顯現。

S.FORM: Râ Meisasou ki sat ka'æutoughan, neni-appa ka kmasâl tyni-æn kmading ti Jesus-an, rou kytt'an nein ta nynnugh, kamamang-appa ka ni-pamt-en, ouhang ni-mahtakout, k'ma, Missing Alak ki Alid ta ti anna.
S.TRANSL: Now when the centurion, and they that were with him, watching Jesus, saw the earthquake, and those things that were done, they feared greatly, saying, Truly this was the Son of God.
百夫長和一同看守耶穌的人看見地震並所經歷的事，就極其害怕，說：「這真是上帝的兒子了！」

S.FORM: Ka ni-æ'ia-koua-hynna ta jnæjna ka mabatoung, matau-tauagh mararau, ka ni-siæ̈ugh ti Jesus-an makka Galileä, alei ka pileilei-eih nein tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: And many women were there beholding afar off, which followed Jesus from Galilee, ministering unto him:
有好些婦女在那裏，遠遠地觀看；她們是從加利利跟隨耶穌來服事他的。

S.FORM: Ka 'æ'ia-tamæuh neini-æn ta ti Maria Magdalena, ta ti Maria ka raren'an ti Jakobus, ti Joses-appa, ki raren'an-appa ki alalak ka papæræh ti Zebedeus.
S.TRANSL: Among which was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of Zebedees children.
內中有抹大拉的馬利亞，又有雅各和約西的母親馬利亞，並有西庇太兩個兒子的母親。

S.FORM: Jrou ka madoung-ato ni-iroua ta voual ka mavangei ka makka Arimathea, ka ti Josef ki nanang, ka Pahtatæutæuughan-appa ti Jesus.
S.TRANSL: When the even was come, there came a rich man of Arimathaea, named Joseph, who also himself was Jesus' disciple:
到了晚上，有一個財主，名叫約瑟，是亞利馬太來的，他也是耶穌的門徒。

S.FORM: Teni ta ni-mou-koua ti Pilatus-an, ka ni-toumimi-en tyn ta vouel ti Jesus. Anna ta ni-madingi ta ti Pilatus ka pæ'æ̈-likoug-hei ta voual.
S.TRANSL: He went to Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus. Then Pilate commanded the body to be delivered.
這人去見彼拉多，求耶穌的身體；彼拉多就吩咐給他。

S.FORM: Jrou ka aran ti Josef ta vouel, ni-toupou tyn ta anna ki äit ka makouptigh ka palyhpigh.
S.TRANSL: And when Joseph had taken the body, he wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,
約瑟取了身體，用乾淨細麻布裹好，

S.FORM: Ka ni-atta-koua-an tyn ta anna tou ravak tyn ka va'æu, ka ni-kou-tæ-æn tyn tou vahto: jrou ka ni-ryhkyllen tyn ta vahto ka irang tou nḡataf ki ravak, ni-d'marang ta teni.
S.TRANSL: And laid it in his own new tomb, which he had hewn out in the rock: and he rolled a great stone to the door of the sepulchre, and departed.
安放在自己的新墳墓裏，就是他鑿在磐石裏的。他又把大石頭滾到墓門口，就去了。

S.FORM: Ka ni-æ'ia-koua-hynna ta ti Maria Magdalena, ti Maria-appa ka saät, ka mierroung ta neni tou dimit ki ravak.
S.TRANSL: And there was Mary Magdalene, and the other Mary, sitting over against the sepulchre.
有抹大拉的馬利亞和那個馬利亞在那裏，對着墳墓坐着。

S.FORM: Râ tou sasat-appa ki wæ'i, ka siæ̈ugh ki sitatanang-en, ni-mæu'isâl ta Sibavau ka Tama-Phik ki Fariseen-appa ti Pilatus-an,
S.TRANSL: Now the next day, that followed the day of the preparation, the chief priests and Pharisees came together unto Pilate,
次日，就是預備日的第二天，祭司長和法利賽人聚集來見彼拉多，說：

S.FORM: Kma, Meirang, hibalei'nian ka ni-mattæ'i-k'ma hynna ki sou ta Tama-patau-rahei ki anna ka mæuagh-appa ta teni, æhpit-aumau siæ̈ugh ki toutouro ki wæi.
S.TRANSL: Saying, Sir, we remember that that deceiver said, while he was yet alive, After three days I will rise again.
「大人，我們記得那誘惑人的還活着的時候曾說：『三日後我要復活。』

S.FORM: Padingi-au hnyn papææu-saoun kmading ta ravak tou kidi ki katatouro ki wæ'i, alei ka assi lava ierrou-'ah ta Pahtatæutæuug-han tyn dou euvanan haouzoung tyni-æn, ka mattæ'i-k'ma-ah-hynna ki ta'u, Ni-patimææ'-æn [pæ-æhpit] ki ni-kapateian: ka komma-hynna masaoun-al-ato mat'e ta taurahei-en ka siæugh ki ni-siouro-ato.
S.TRANSL: Command therefore that the sepulchre be made sure until the third day, lest his disciples come by night, and steal him away, and say unto the people, He is risen from the dead: so the last error shall be worse than the first.
因此，請吩咐人將墳墓把守妥當，直到第三日，恐怕他的門徒來，把他偷了去，就告訴百姓說：『他從死裏復活了。』這樣，那後來的迷惑比先前的更利害了！」

S.FORM: Râ ni-k'ma neini-æn ta ti Pilatus, Akou-mea-kamou ki kmakading, ou-koua-au, papæu-saoun-auto ki anna mama ki kava-na'noumi.
S.TRANSL: Pilate said unto them, Ye have a watch: go your way, make it as sure as ye can.
彼拉多說：「你們有看守的兵，去吧！盡你們所能的把守妥當。」

S.FORM: Jrou ka d'marang ta neni, ni-papæu-saoun-nen nein ki kmakading ta ravak, rou ni-pou-kaha'n nein pou-tapoei-ou pou-kidi ta vahto.
S.TRANSL: So they went, and made the sepulchre sure, sealing the stone, and setting a watch.
他們就帶着看守的兵同去，封了石頭，將墳墓把守妥當。
